result.summary: The page is largely clean and well-structured. No critical or major visual defects were found; horizontal clipping and bottom cutoff are expected carousel/viewport behavior. The only notable inconsistency is the favorite (heart) button treatment differing between the two 'Popular right now' cards.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently across cards: on the pizza card it sits on a dark circular scrim, while on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card it is a bare white outline with no background container. This makes the control look unfinished on the ramen card and reduces its visibility if the underlying image were lighter.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular semi-transparent dark scrim behind the heart icon on every restaurant card so the control is consistent and always legible regardless of image brightness.

issues.description: Cards in the 'Fastest near you' carousel show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards include rating, time, and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata in the carousel makes it harder to compare options at a glance.
issues.suggestion: Consider adding a compact rating (e.g., star + score) or cuisine tag to the carousel cards for consistency and better decision-making, if space allows.
